items.title: Local measurements reveal global quantum properties in a constant number of experimental runs
items.abstract: A quantum device with more qubits is harder to verify. Describing a general quantum state takes an exponential number of parameters, and reconstructing it in full—a procedure known as state tomography—becomes impractical as the system grows.
